title: How a deep clean is usually done
lead: Usually one visit. This is an example mouth, not yours.

steps.label: Remove the tartar
steps.words: Hardened tartar is cleaned off the teeth and just under the gum edge.

steps.label: Polish
steps.words: The teeth are polished smooth so less builds up again.

steps.label: A fortnight later
steps.words: The gum is usually calmer and less swollen. Brushing and flossing keep it that way.
